summary: Gray Media, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of two tranches of asset acquisitions from Allen Media Group. On March 27, 2026, it acquired stations WTVA, WTHI, and WLFI for $56M plus working capital adjustments. On May 1, 2026, it acquired nine additional stations (WAAY, WSIL, WEVV, WFFT, WCOV, WIYE, KADN, KLAF, WREX) for $115M plus working capital adjustments, totaling $171M for all Allen Media Stations. Both were all-cash transactions funded from available cash. The SEC granted a waiver from Rule 3-05/Article 11 financial statements, substituting an audited Statement of Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed. No premium, break fee, or advisor named. Watch for the filing of the substituted financial statements within 71 days.
